cards.ex: It's hard to escape the filter bubble when social media algorithms only show you what you already agree with.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq algoritmlari faqat siz rozi bo'lgan narsalarni ko'rsatganda, filtr pufagidan qochish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Internetda shaxsiy qiziqishlarga mos keladigan ma'lumotlar bilan o'ralash

cards.ex: Becoming a digital nomad was the best decision I ever made; I can work from anywhere!
cards.exUz: Raqamli ko'chmanchi bo'lish men qabul qilgan eng yaxshi qaror edi; men har qanday joydan ishlashim mumkin!
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali ishlaydigan va joydan joyga ko'chib yuradigan shaxs

cards.ex: I started watching cat videos and ended up going down the rabbit hole of conspiracy theories.
cards.exUz: Men mushuk videolarini tomosha qilishni boshladim va oxir-oqibat fitna nazariyalari chuquriga tushib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Bir mavzuga qiziqib, u haqida ko'p vaqt sarflash

cards.ex: That app became popular virtually overnight; everyone's using it now.
cards.exUz: Bu ilova deyarli bir kechada mashhur bo'lib ketdi; hozir hamma undan foydalanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qisqa vaqt ichida, juda tez

cards.ex: Don't pay attention to keyboard warriors; they're just trying to get a reaction.
cards.exUz: Klaviatura jangchilariga e'tibor bermang; ular shunchaki reaksiya olishga harakat qilishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tajovuzkor bo'lgan, lekin hayotda uyatchan shaxs

cards.ex: We're planning an IRL meetup for our online gaming group next month.
cards.exUz: Biz keyingi oy onlayn o'yin guruhimiz uchun HAda uchrashuv rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tanishgan odamlarning haqiqiy hayotda uchrashuvi

cards.ex: I think she's oversharing on social media; everyone knows her business.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda haddan tashqari ko'p ma'lumot oshkor qilmoqda; hamma uning ishlarini biladi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni haddan tashqari ko'p oshkor qilish

cards.ex: I prefer to stream content rather than download it.
cards.exUz: Men kontentni yuklab olishdan ko'ra translyatsiya qilishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali video, musiqa yoki boshqa ma'lumotlarni uzatish

cards.ex: Our society has become so tech-dependent that we can't function without our devices.
cards.exUz: Jamiyatimiz texnologiyaga shunchalik bog'liq bo'lib qoldiki, biz qurilmalarimizsiz ishlay olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalarga juda ko'p tayanadigan

cards.ex: Sometimes I just want to go off-grid and escape all the digital noise.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan men shunchaki tarmoqdan uzilib, barcha raqamli shovqinlardan qochishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan butunlay voz kechish

cards.ex: It's getting harder to tell the difference between real people and social bots online.
cards.exUz: Internetda haqiqiy odamlar va ijtimoiy botlar o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlash tobora qiyinlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda avtomatik ravishda harakat qiladigan dastur

cards.ex: Social media can become an echo chamber if you only follow people who agree with you.
cards.exUz: Agar siz faqat sizga rozi bo'lgan odamlarni kuzatsangiz, ijtimoiy media akssado xonaga aylanishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarning faqat tasdiqlanishi muhiti

cards.ex: We need to be aware of algorithmic bias in AI systems.
cards.exUz: Biz AI tizimlaridagi algoritmik tarafkashlikdan xabardor bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Algoritmlar tomonidan yaratilgan tarafkashlik yoki adolatsizlik

cards.ex: In the attention economy, companies are constantly fighting for our time and focus.
cards.exUz: Diqqat iqtisodiyotida kompaniyalar doimo bizning vaqtimiz va e'tiborimiz uchun kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat resurs sifatida baholanadigan tizim

cards.ex: Cancel culture can be harsh and unforgiving.
cards.exUz: Bekor qilish madaniyati shafqatsiz va kechirmaydigan bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri harakatlari uchun odamlarni ommaviy qoralash

cards.ex: It's important to prioritize digital wellbeing and set boundaries with technology.
cards.exUz: Raqamli farovonlikni ustuvor qilish va texnologiya bilan chegaralar belgilash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan sog'lom va muvozanatli foydalanish

cards.ex: She's a successful content creator on YouTube.
cards.exUz: U YouTube'da muvaffaqiyatli kontent yaratuvchisi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda kontent yaratadigan shaxs

cards.ex: Digital literacy is essential in today's world.
cards.exUz: Raqamli savodxonlik bugungi kunda juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Raqamli texnologiyalardan samarali foydalanish qobiliyati

cards.ex: Don't feed the internet trolls; just ignore them.
cards.exUz: Internet trollarini boqmang; shunchaki ularga e'tibor bermang.
cards.uzDef: Internetda provokatsiya qiladigan odam

cards.ex: Cyberbullying can have serious consequences.
cards.exUz: Kiberbulling jiddiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali ta'qib qilish

cards.ex: Social media influencers can have a big impact on consumer behavior.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq ta'sir o'tkazuvchilari iste'molchilar xulq-atvoriga katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda katta ta'sirga ega shaxs

cards.ex: I'm going live on Instagram later to talk about my new book.
cards.exUz: Men keyinroq Instagramda yangi kitobim haqida gapirish uchun jonli efirga chiqaman.
cards.uzDef: Internetda jonli video translyatsiya qilish

cards.ex: Online privacy is a growing concern for many people.
cards.exUz: Onlayn maxfiylik ko'pchilik uchun tobora dolzarb muammoga aylanib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni internetda himoya qilish

cards.ex: Companies use data mining to understand consumer behavior.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar iste'molchilar xulq-atvorini tushunish uchun ma'lumot qazishdan foydalanadilar.
cards.uzDef: Katta ma'lumotlar to'plamlaridan ma'lumot olish

cards.ex: I have a smart device that controls the lights in my house.
cards.exUz: Mening uyimdagi chiroqlarni boshqaradigan aqlli qurilmam bor.
cards.uzDef: Internetga ulangan va turli funksiyalarni bajaradigan qurilma

cards.ex: I need to unsubscribe from all these newsletters.
cards.exUz: Men bu barcha yangiliklardan obunani bekor qilishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Elektron pochta xabarlarini olishni to'xtatish

cards.ex: Spoiler alert: Don't read this if you haven't seen the movie!
cards.exUz: Buzg'unchi ogohlantirish: Agar filmni ko'rmagan bo'lsangiz, buni o'qimang!
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning muhim detallarini ochib berishdan oldin ogohlantirish

cards.ex: I need to reduce my screen time and spend more time outdoors.
cards.exUz: Men ekran vaqtimni qisqartirishim va ko'proq vaqtni tashqarida o'tkazishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ekran oldida o'tkazilgan vaqt

cards.ex: They're using crowdfunding to raise money for their startup.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z startupi uchun pul yig'ish uchun ommaviy moliyalashtirishdan foydalanmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Odamlardan pul yig'ish orqali loyihani moliyalashtirish

cards.ex: I watched the concert on livestream.
cards.exUz: Men konsertni jonli translyatsiyada tomosha qildim.
cards.uzDef: Internetda jonli video ko'rsatish
